name: Ling Guo
source: Ling Guo is married to Xiao Long, the ruler of vampires in Asia. She is an overly ambitious woman, however, she knows how to bide her time and has a lot of patience waiting for her schemes to come to fruition. She was born into a very poor family and has elevated her status through whatever means necessary.
